div.div: Each Slack message is checked, filtered, deduped, routed and recorded before the 200; delivery to the workstream relay runs after it, within the hourly budget, with retries and a pending queue

switch.text: Each Slack message is checked, filtered, deduped, routed and recorded before the 200; delivery to the workstream relay runs after it, within the hourly budget, with retries and a pending queue

div.div:
Human message
top-level message or
thread reply

Verify
256 KB cap, else 413 ·
signature and timestamp
within 300 s, else 401

Filter
bot · subtype ·
unmapped channel ·
external user: ignored

Dedupe
message record already
in KV: 200, stop

Route
1 prefix or @mention
2 thread claim
3 channel map

Record, then 200
message record; thread
map for a top-level
message (KV)

Workstream agents
Root, Forge, Ember and Other sessions

text.tspan: Root, Forge, Ember and Other sessions

div.div:
POST /claim
hand a thread to a workstream

POST /reserve
Root, before it delivers to a project

GET /ledger
route and reply lines since a time
Shared state · used by the request path, delivery and API

switch.text: Shared state · used by the request path, delivery and API

div.div:
Thread map (KV)
channel + thread → workstream,
30 days, last claim wins

RelayGate
Durable Object per workstream,
50 runs per UTC hour

Message records (KV)
one per message; metadata
is the ledger line, 35 days

Cron every 10 min
up to 8 entries, expired
first, then oldest first

Pending (KV)
gate refusal or outage, 429,
5xx, network error or
timeout; deadline 1 h

Give up (D2)
401, 404, 413, other 4xx,
or past the deadline

Reserve
RelayGate grant, valid
60 s; 2 s timeout,
fail closed

Relay POST
X-Webhook-Secret
5 s timeout, retries
after 2 s and 6 s

Ack (D1)
thread reply or
eyes reaction

Relay webhook
Factory automation per
workstream; 2xx = accepted,
then it wakes the session

Thread replies and alert
D1 ack · D2 retrying, hold and give-up notices
Root channel alert

text.tspan: D1 ack · D2 retrying, hold and give-up notices
